title: Work and technology
description: Name the tools of a modern job and say what each one is for.
grammar: para and the infinitive: what a tool is for
grammarNote: Para says what a thing is for: el portátil es para trabajar.

explanation.summary: A modern job runs on a small set of tools, and each one has a purpose. Para plus the infinitive says what each tool is for, and that is the whole grammar of this unit.

sections.heading: The tools
sections.body: El portátil is the computer you carry, and la pantalla is what you look at. El clic is what the finger does, and el cursor is what moves. La contraseña opens everything, and el programa is what runs inside.

examples.es: Muevo el cursor con un clic.
examples.en: I move the cursor with a click.

sections.heading: The new way of working
sections.body: El teletrabajo is work from home, and la videollamada is the meeting on the screen. El robot does the repeated part of a job, and descargar is what you do with a file before you can use it.

examples.es: Hago teletrabajo tres días por semana.
examples.en: I work from home three days a week.

examples.es: La videollamada es a las diez.
examples.en: The video call is at ten.
I download the file in order to read it.

items.note: Masculine: el portátil. The accent marks the stress.
Feminine: la contraseña. The ñ is its own letter.
Masculine: el teletrabajo. Work done from home.
The verb descargar: descargo, descargas, descarga.
